comment: Round 2 gold answers: vendor response and changed facts for the Northwind Materials SaaS procurement matter.

issues.title: Data centre exclusion from on-site audits acceptable with certifications
issues.description: Vendor excludes data centres from on-site audits, which Internal Audit accepts if current ISO 27001 and SOC 2 reports are provided annually.

evidence.quote: Data centres are excluded from on-site audits

issues.rationale: In response R-6, Cverbio conceded on-site audits at its offices while excluding data centres. Client update U-3 permits this compromise provided annual ISO 27001 and SOC 2 reports are supplied; counsel must negotiate those certificate obligations into the contract.

issues.title: Proposed 7% annual fee increase cap exceeds playbook limit
issues.description: Vendor proposes capping fee increases at 7% per year, exceeding the 5% playbook fallback cap.

evidence.quote:
increases are
limited to 7% per year

issues.rationale: In response R-7, Cverbio caps annual fee increases at 7%. PB-09 fallback is 5% and the limit specifically requires escalating any cap above 5%.

issues.title: Proposed 72-hour breach notification period exceeds playbook limit
issues.description: Vendor offers notification within 72 hours, which exceeds the 48-hour playbook limit.

evidence.quote:
personal data breach within 72 hours of
becoming aware of it

issues.rationale: In response R-4, Cverbio offers a 72-hour notification period. PB-05 fallback is 48 hours and the limit mandates escalating any period longer than 48 hours, as a 72-hour window leaves Northwind zero time to meet its own Art. 33 GDPR deadline.

issues.title: Omitted Annex 3 sub-processors list
issues.description: Vendor response refers to Annex 3 for the sub-processors list, but the annex was not attached.

evidence.quote: Annex 3 was not attached to the Cverbio response

issues.rationale: Response R-3 refers to the current sub-processor list in Annex 3, but client update U-5 confirms the annex was omitted, leaving sub-processors unverified.

issues.title: Health surveillance records require liability escalation
issues.description: Operations decided to upload employee occupational health surveillance records, triggering mandatory escalation of all liability terms.

evidence.quote:
platform will also hold occupational health
surveillance records for around 180 laboratory employees who work with hazardous
substances

issues.rationale: Update U-1 introduces special categories of personal data (health surveillance records). Under PB-07, when special categories are processed, the fallback is unavailable and every liability position must be escalated to GC and CFO.

issues.title: Perpetual derivative products licence exceeds playbook fallback
issues.description: Vendor excludes personal data from service improvement licence but retains perpetual licence for derivative products.

evidence.quote:
licence remains perpetual and irrevocable and continues to
cover derivative products

issues.rationale: Response R-2 excludes Customer Personal Data, but retains a perpetual irrevocable licence covering derivative products. PB-02 requires negotiating this down to irreversibly anonymised statistical data that cannot identify Northwind.

issues.title: Missing intra-group agreement and transfer impact assessment
issues.description: Vendor asserts cross-border access is covered by intra-group agreement, but neither agreement nor TIA has been provided.

evidence.quote:
We have also not received
Cverbio's intra-group agreement or any transfer impact assessment

issues.rationale: Response R-8 relies on an intra-group agreement for cross-border support access from the US and India, but update U-5 confirms neither the agreement nor the transfer impact assessment has been provided.

issues.title: Works council remains unnotified with advanced go-live date
issues.description: Works council has not yet been informed of third-country access to employee data while go-live is accelerated to 15 January 2027.

evidence.quote:
works council has not yet been informed that employee data can be accessed
from outside the EEA

issues.rationale: PB-04 limit requires escalating unnotified third-country access to employee data; update U-4 confirms the works council remains unnotified with an earlier go-live date approaching.

issues.title: Intra-group agreement assertion conflicts with unexecuted transfer mechanism clause
issues.description: Response R-8 claims remote access is covered by intra-group agreement, while DPA section 9 leaves transfer mechanisms to be addressed if and when needed.

evidence.quote:
parties shall address any
required transfer mechanism separately if and when the need arises

issues.rationale: Response R-8 asserts that international access is covered by Cverbio existing intra-group agreement, contradicting Section 9 of the DPA which states the parties will address transfer mechanisms if and when the need arises.
